evidence.title: Datasenter på Undheim
evidence.excerpt: Green Mountain's live project page says earthworks, concrete work, and foundation pouring are underway at its two-building Undheim data-center development.

metadata.status_scope: The live page says work on the Undheim plot is already underway and specifically names earthworks, concrete work, and foundation pouring. Because the source does not assign one uniform substage to both connected buildings, it supports one generic project under_construction observation as of retrieval rather than a foundations-stage claim.
metadata.project_scope: The source describes one current development comprising two interconnected data-center buildings and associated infrastructure. No separate building or phase entities are created.
metadata.capacity_scope: The page expressly distinguishes planned IT capacity of 80 MW from total effect capacity of 100 MW. They are represented once at the current two-building project scope as planned critical-IT and gross-facility observations and are not additive to each other.
metadata.capacity_guardrail: Neither figure is current load, grid-connection capacity, generation, measured consumption, annual energy, or evidence of operation. The Norwegian total-effect wording is treated as gross facility demand, not IT load.
metadata.reported_completion_window: staged customer handover through final completion during 2028
metadata.completion_guardrail: The 2028 handover and completion wording is forward-looking and does not establish completion, commissioning, energization, or operation.
metadata.classification_guardrail: High-capacity, high-performance, air-cooling, liquid-cooling, heat-reuse, and unnamed international-customer wording describes design or commercial context. It creates no normalized workload, operating model, tenant, customer, user, or hardware observation.
metadata.role_scope: The source explicitly says Green Mountain is developing the project. The unnamed customer and DC Nordic contractor remain metadata; no customer identity or operator role is inferred.
metadata.locality_guardrail: Undheim in Time municipality, Rogaland is authoritative locality context only. No street address, parcel, point, footprint, geometry, or unique-site claim is created.
metadata.rights_scope: Compact factual extraction from an all-rights-reserved operator page; the captured page and media are not redistributed.
metadata.imagery_guardrail: Publisher imagery, satellite imagery, aerial imagery, computer vision, and analyst geolocation do not contribute to identity, locality, lifecycle, capacity, role, or classification.
